verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents Python and TypeScript SDKs for running evaluations programmatically against datasets. Its dataset evaluators act as test cases forming "an evaluation harness similar to a unit test suite," used to tell whether an update is an improvement or a regression. That is the core of a CI eval step, but nothing documents running it in CI or gating deployments on the results. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g., GitHub Actions or another CI recipe), pass/fail thresholds or exit codes for gating deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
